bio: The beleaguered hydromancer on The Grim Tidings, Gillum tries to do things by the book. That book being his enchanted ship's log, that allows him to quiet whirlpools, dispel storms, and otherwise steer the rickety bilgebarge he calls home across Amara's seas. And what thanks does he get for his work? Nothing. Barely a nod of approval from his crew. Well, they'd all be at sea without him.
